description: English PocketTTS Small 18m, 7m, and 2m models, with regular and ReFL variants, for text-to-speech and voice cloning.

request.name: frames_after_eos
request.description: Extra frames after EOS; -1 uses the model-derived value.

request.name: max_frames
request.description: Maximum generated audio frames; zero estimates the cap from text length. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: text_chunk_tokens
request.description: Tokenizer tokens per text chunk; must be positive, default 50. Set during preparation and overridable per request.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Positive flow noise temperature; defaults to the model configuration. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: seed
request.description: Noise seed; omitted chooses a random seed. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: noise_clamp
request.description: Noise clamp; a negative value disables clamping. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: eos_threshold
request.description: EOS detection threshold; defaults to the checkpoint recommendation.

request.name: noise_file
request.description: Precomputed noise schedule file. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: voice_embedding_file
request.description: Precomputed voice-state embedding path. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: truncate_clone_audio
request.description: Truncate voice clone audio. Captured during session preparation.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Optional per-request character chunk size; otherwise use sentence/token budgeting.

request.name: export_voice_state_file
request.description: Export the prepared voice state during session preparation.

session.name: attention
session.description: GGML acoustic attention implementation.

session.name: kv_cache_type
session.description: GGML acoustic KV cache storage. Native CPU flow requires f32.

session.name: voice_state_cache_slots
session.description: Cached prepared voice states; zero disables reuse.

session.name: offline_graph_capacity_mode
session.description: Offline graph capacity policy; CPU/Metal default tiered, other backends double.

session.name: prompt_graph_capacity
session.description: Optional reserved prompt capacity.

session.name: generation_graph_capacity
session.description: Optional reserved generation capacity.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Shared matmul weight storage; component matmul settings inherit it. Convolution storage remains independently native unless overridden.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Convolution weight storage.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Context or graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: flow_weight_context_mb
session.description: Flow weight context in MiB; inherits pocket_tts_small.weight_context_mb when omitted.

session.name: mimi_encoder_weight_context_mb
session.description: Mimi encoder weight context in MiB; inherits pocket_tts_small.weight_context_mb when omitted.

session.name: mimi_decoder_weight_context_mb
session.description: Mimi decoder weight context in MiB; inherits pocket_tts_small.weight_context_mb when omitted.

session.name: flow_weights_view_context_mb
session.description: Context or graph arena size in MiB.

session.name: flow_step_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Flow-step host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: mimi_encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi encoder host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: mimi_conv_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi convolution host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: mimi_transformer_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi transformer host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: mimi_tail_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Mimi tail host graph-metadata arena size in MiB, not device workspace.

session.name: mimi_chunk_frames
session.description: Latent frames per bounded causal waveform-decoder block.

session.name: mimi_stage2_chunk_frames
session.description: Second-stage decoder chunk frames.

session.name: use_full_mimi
session.description: Use a full-utterance waveform graph instead of bounded causal blocks. This can use more device memory.

session.name: exec_plan
session.description: Component execution plan. Flow defaults to ggml; native is an experimental CPU F32 implementation with an optional threads parameter.
